map.每单位红细胞一定 +10 g/L 吗？: Does each red cell unit always raise +10 g/L?
map.是成人经验均值，受血容量、出血、溶血影响；儿童按体重换算（每 kg 约 4–6: It is the adult empirical mean, affected by blood volume, bleeding and haemolysis; children convert by weight (about 4-6 mL/kg red cell suspension per kg raises about 10 g/L), and the actual result follows the post-transfusion blood count.
map.CCI 低说明什么？: What does a low CCI mean?
map.1h CCI≤7.5 或 24h≤4.5 提示输注无效，常见于同种免疫、发热/感: 1h CCI ≤7.5 or 24h ≤4.5 suggests ineffective transfusion, commonly from alloimmunisation, fever / infection / bleeding / DIC causing platelet consumption; investigate the consumption cause and consider typed / HLA-matched platelets.
